name: measurement_semantics_resolution
description: Select one existing complete machine measurement that best represents the conceptual quantity requested by the user; Python owns all field/provenance reconstruction and winner derivation.
stopping_condition: Return one existing measurement_id when the semantic mapping is defensible; otherwise return null and explain the ambiguity.
decision_contract: Return only selected_measurement_id, reason, and confidence. Never return field names, support IDs, SPL, candidates, winners, or scope changes.
